facts.fact: An expert quoted by the document described Madagascar's digital ID as linked with civil registration, under a retroactive civil registration framework letting undocumented people obtain foundational documents.
Government figures say 2.6 million people were enrolled in the digital ID system in two months, about 8% of the 32.7 million population (computed from the population given).
